summary: Episodes 60-65 are six consecutive canon rows in the Holy Ordeal arc, adapting PRINTED chapters 217-232 (tankobon vols 24-25) in strict running order, with ONE out-of-order insertion: ep 61 is the unnumbered bangaihen side story. Ep 60 finishes ch 217 (the execution notice) and runs to the opening of 220 'The Fifth Symbol' where Flora names Leona the fifth apostle and begins to tell Avan's past; ep 61 then plays that past as the whole episode, adapting the unnumbered side story 番外編「勇者アバン」 (V Jump, Nov 1991; printed as bonus matter at the back of tankobon vol 13, between printed ch 121 and 122) OUT OF ORDER, and carries no mainline chapter at all (A44 anchor_hostile + side_story). Eps 62-65 then run 221 -> 232 with a clean mid-chapter split at 223, 226 and 229 and a clean close on 232 'Gather!! The Five Disciples'. EVERY number below is the PRINTED space (tankobon 1-348) per the wave-14 contract. THE SUB-BLOCK'S STRUCTURAL FINDING, reached independently here and concurred by sub-block B: dragonquest.fandom's per-episode `adapted` field is ALREADY PRINTED in this range — the ruled N35 sourceShift {fandom, from 208, delta -1} is wrong and its true seam sits ~130 chapters higher (around the fandom's 338). anchor_hostile.why: A44 position-less: ep 61 特別篇「勇者アバン」 adapts the UNNUMBERED side story 番外編「勇者アバン」 in full and no numbered mainline chapter at all. The side story ran in V Jump (Nov 1991) during the WSJ serialization and is printed as bonus matter at the BACK OF TANKOBON VOL 13, between printed ch 121 覇者の剣 and ch 122 決勝戦の異変!! — the catalog's chapter space is the PRINTED 348, which does not number it (N35), so there is no chapter number to anchor on. Both per-episode sources say the same thing and neither names a mainline chapter: the fandom's field is literally 'Special chapter: Avan, The Hero — Side Story' and coco13 writes 'アニメ第61話は原作13巻番外編の"勇者アバン"だよ'. Toei's synopsis is 100% that story (young Avan in Flora's Carl knights, shirking guard duty to research cooking; Hadlar storms Carl castle; Avan's 毒蛾の粉 and his flash strike drive Hadlar off; Avan and Roka set out) — ja-WP independently attributes 毒蛾の粉 to 「外伝・勇者アバン」, and the fandom's chapter page for the side story lists exactly that cast (Hadlar, Flora, Avan, Roka). The row stays CANON (a side story printed inside the source IS the source — never side_source) with a `side_story` annotation; the reader's position does not move (continue 220 above).
